android_observations.note: loaded + validated + bound by its file SHA-256; the Android platform's own observations, cross-corroborated against the ADCOS-side observations -- never overriding them (do not duplicate the Android platform authority in Python)

claims: the handset participates as a real ADCOS endpoint
the physical trigger (the Wi-Fi disable) occurred
PHYSICAL.basis: the physical execution record (is_physical) + the adb-observed device identity

claims: the Android framework's own access-technology observations (pre/post)
PLATFORM.basis: the framework's own reports captured by the harness (getprop/dumpsys) and/or the bound Android observation manifest -- never ADCOS re-derivation

claims: the OLD path record (identity, interface, route, reachability, validation state)
the NEW path record (the USB-tether host path)
PATH.basis: the real host route/interface observations + the participant's own transition record (honest even in a rehearsal: the loopback path is a genuinely observed path)

claims: the session established and bound (primary carriage)
the re-bind on the SAME logical session id (secondary)
the session-record digest stability across the transition
ADCOS.basis: the participant's own journal events (session-bound + session-rebound on one session id) + the byte-identical session-record digest

claims: the protected datagram flowed on the new path
the independent receiver corroborates the session datagrams on BOTH access points
TRANSPORT.basis: the post-rebind payload digest + the receiver journal's both-carriage corroboration (the sender's own send record alone never proves this layer)

android_nr_report.basis: the framework's post-transition NR report (technology='none' is_5g=False)

cellular_network_active.basis: the framework's cellular data-network state (manifest cellular.active=True)

host_path_identified.basis: the host USB-tether interface 'enxdaf7b654e4cf' + the post-transition route running via it (route 'default via 192.168.117.153 dev enxdaf7b654e4cf proto dhcp src 192.168.117.142 m')

adcos_path_validated.basis: the new path record's validation state ('ACTIVE (constituent; candidate probe reachable=True; protected traffic probe verified=False)')

adcos_session_bound_to_path.basis: the bind + rebind events on the SAME session id (before='sha256:a497927ae47fed863' after='sha256:a497927ae47fed863')

real_packet_transmitted.basis: the digest of the protected datagram that flowed after the re-bind ('sha256:cecf52044f69ea915')

independent_receiver_verification.basis: the independent receiver (appliance) journal corroborating the session datagram on the relay carriage
